anchor.classification_basis: Actual generator UI selection; prompt preserved verbatim

actual_submitted_design_lines: WEAR: the long, pompadour-like, yellow antenna becomes slim antenna-like hair ornaments; the purple shell becomes a dome-backed mantle over her shoulders and upper back, its rim framing both shoulders.

FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): angular face, balanced length, wide width; wide heavy chin; almond eyes, large size, level outer corners, close-set; thick low brows; small delicate nose; wide mouth.
rationale_reviewed_at_completion: Boxing claw mass and raised antenna cues were interpreted by the repository design as a wide angular jaw and low thick brows; the generated anchor retains a long almond eye and compact mouth.

actual_face_comparison.method: Actual light images were compared side by side, including cropped face/neck views. Crops are session QA only, not newly generated comparison sheets.
actual_face_comparison.observation: Crabrawler has a wider angular lower face, elongated almond eyes, thick low brows and a narrow central nose. Crabominable has a longer oval cheek contour, a broad but softer jaw, more open eyes and a smaller upper-lip arc. Recent Meowstic has rounder eyes and a small pointed chin; Honedge has narrower eyes and a longer straight nose/face; Fuecoco has a round shorter face and broad open mouth. Hair and ornaments were not used as the sole distinguishing evidence.

anatomy: Automatic checker unavailable (mediapipe absent); all nine were inspected visually, including full-size hand/foot crops. Detailed occlusion and finger observations are in qa.json.
workflow: Thumbnail and registration workflows succeeded. Remaining annotations concern pre-existing style sample sizes and Actions Node runtime deprecation, not these new assets.
